note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is not uniform across the 2068 published episodes: 956 records carry `{cost_steps, plan_changes, pr, success, tests_passed}`, 955 add `handoff`, 145 omit both `pr` and `handoff`, 11 add `handoff` and `xfailed` while omitting `pr`, and 1 carries all seven, so the datasets-server infers the struct from the first shard and then cannot cast the later ones into a parquet index.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool across six shapes (`command`; `path`; `path` + `contents`; `path` + `old` + `new`; `path` + `pattern`; `path` + `pattern` + `glob`)

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 158 of 31549 steps; always a string where present

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool), `plan_changes`, `tests_passed` and `cost_steps` (int) on every record, plus `pr` on 1912, `handoff` on 967 and `xfailed` on 12 of 2068 records

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator` and `round` on every record; declared `json` so a later round may carry an extra key without breaking the index

disclosures.summary: `reward` has five key sets, and they are the shapes the inferred schema died on: 956 records `{cost_steps, plan_changes, pr, success, tests_passed}`, 955 the same plus `handoff`, 145 without `pr` or `handoff`, 11 with `handoff` and `xfailed` but no `pr`, and 1 with all seven keys. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: Every record is a `secret-scan-remediation-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, with the same seven top-level keys and the same `meta` key set on all 2068 records. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.

8 episodes are goaled on an over-broad scanner allowlist or a stale scan baseline that hides a live leak, rather than on a freshly committed credential. That is the advertised leftover-allowlist / baseline mechanic of this factory, not a generation defect.

The credential-shaped strings in this payload are synthetic fixtures: 2064 of the 2068 episodes label theirs with a `TESTONLY_` prefix, and the remaining four use other placeholder text. Nothing here is a live credential.
